avis.texte: Never used this before but a convert to roozel products so gave it a try. It's the perfect way to finish a shave. It seems to seal your skin and provide a nice smooth surface, ready for moisturising. Essential part of that perfect wet shave.
Love this stuff makes my skin feel clean. Always use the night before a shave
I use this after shaving, and sometimes just to freshen up and smooth my skin. Feels great, cooling, no burn. Must have.
Feels great after a shave, awesome cooling effect without the burn of most aftershaves.

Smells good, feels nice and clean, but very runny. It turns into a liquid as soon as you squirt it onto your hands. Then it's hard to splash it on your face without losing any. If it was slightly thicker like a gel or foamy like shaving cream, it would be perfect.
This product feels amazing on my skin after a shave . So refreshing and makes my face so smooth
The astringent foam provides a clean and cool feeling after my shave routine.

Bought this after seeing a review by Ash on The Chaps Guide. Good price, fast shipping and easy to use. Shake it up then squeeze out a dollop of foam on your palm. Rub your hands together and apply to your freshly shaved face. Soothing and has a pleasant neutral scent.
Was looking for a new astringent this one makes face feel clean after using
Awesome new product Feels great and really refreshing after a close shave - or even without the razor Very nice stuff !!

Great Astringent. Clean and refreshing. Doesn't leave any weird residue. Easy to apply. Skin feels clean like it should. Great as a refresh after work. Its quick and easy to. Pleasant smell that will not interfere with cologne.
This product is incredible! Super refreshing after your shave!
I'm really enjoying this product and how easy it is to use. It has a light fragrance that does not overpower at all.

Love this product for my scalp and neck line which can get easily irritated from shaving. I apply after shave immediately after shaving and will use this astringent foam between shaves to keep my pores tight.
This product is amazing. Use after shaving really soothes and leaves your face refreshed and moisturized. Drys quickly and has a great scent. Love the squeeze bottle application.

avis.titre: Great stuff and the only one I use
avis.texte: This Astringent Foam and all the rest of the Reuzel line are wonderful. Skin feels wonderful!
I had a previous astringent face was that was discontinued. This is a great replacement!
Really like how this product does not make your face feel greasy. It cleans and leaves the face feeling fresh. The smell is also greay! Shipping and online service was very quick and easy.
This stuff is a magic potion that leaves you face younger that it was.

I switched my regular toner to this and now it's a product I cannot live without. Works fantastic and keeps your skin looking great and people will never know your age. Unless your beard is mostly grey like mine. But it's definitely a go to.
Leaves my face clean and soft after working a 12 hour shift would most definitely recommend and am purchasing again
Great to get my face and beard clean before going to bed or before a shave
This astringent is nice and light and takes the grossness of the day away!
This is the best "aftershave" I have found. It works amazingly on my extremely sensitive skin, helping to soothe and tone the skin. Recommend this product to everyone!
I bought this for work! And it has been a hit! I love that its a foam! Smells great too
Helps me keep the razor bumps away when other aftershaves weren't doing the trick. Light on the skin without the sting. Smells good too!
I have used this product several times after shaving and I absolutely love this product. It tightens and soothes your skin after shaving. It can really wake your skin up in the morning.

avis.titre: AMAZING! You need this in your shaving kit!
avis.texte: I'll admit I was skeptical at first, but this foam is great! Makes your skin feel great after a shave and closes up your pores without making your skin oily or giving you a burning sensation. The foam keeps your skin soft all day long after a morning shave! Now they just need to make a travel size version!
I'm a barber and I use the astringent foam around my clients ears and neck after using the razor on the outline and nape. Cools and cleans the skin with a great smell that clients love
No burning after application smells great and reduces irritation!
Feels amazing on my skin and doesn't make my face feel all oily
Great product for that final clean up , getting the neck area and face after using the straight razor
I love this product after giving a straight razor shave. It has just enough heat to let the client know it is working without burning their face off.

This was obviously created by rocket scientist because I have no idea how something without shaking and is not an aerosol yet foams almost like a mousse. It is truly an amazing product. I shave in the shower so I apply it in the shower after I shave. Thanks to the team at NASA that helped create it! 10 STARS!
Best astringent ever to use after shaving! Smells wonderful and works well!!!
